text: According to the chapter's table of key theorems, Diaconescu's theorem states that in a topos:
choices: Every monomorphism is a pullback of $\top:1\to\Omega$
The axiom of choice (epimorphisms split) implies the internal logic is Boolean
Every topos admits a surjective Boolean cover
explanation: Diaconescu's theorem is listed as 'AC in a topos $\Rightarrow$ Boolean logic,' so the axiom of choice forces classical (Boolean) internal logic. Option 0 merely restates the defining property of the subobject classifier; option 2 is Barr's theorem; and option 3 is the comparison theorem, each a separate entry in the same table.
